name: Santa Eulàlia de Ronçana (Spain)
description: Light green field with a white saltire throughout, its arms one ninth of the height.
history: The flag was approved on 20 February 2013 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 6327 of 4 March 2013; it is based on the arms, an oblong flag of 2:3, light green, with a white saltire throughout 1/9 of the height thick.

features.role: saltire with arms 1/9 of the height
